description:
Remedies of one graha (`graha`: sun, moon, mars, mercury, jupiter, venus, saturn, rahu, ketu): the Vedic mantra with its BPHS japa count, the beeja mantra, the graha shanti (image material, contemplation, samidh, food), dakshina, colour and weekday, rudraksha mukhi, yantra, fasting day, and links to the gemstone and Lal Kitab routes. `doshas` lists the doshas that draw on this graha. Optional `type` filter.

[Group: Vedic]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/vedic/remedies/by-graha]
[Required: graha]
[Cost: 5 credits (Tier ½)]

type.description: Remedy type, or a comma list of them: mantra, puja, deity, yantra, rudraksha, fasting, charity, colour, gemstone, lal-kitab. All types when omitted.

name: astroway_vedic_remedies_by_graha
title: Remedies for one graha
